question: Why does the electric field inside a dielectric decrease when it is placed in an external electric field $E_0$?

options.A: Because the dielectric absorbs the electric field lines.
options.B: Because an induced electric field is set up inside the dielectric opposite to $E_0$.
options.C: Because the dielectric conducts charge to neutralize the field.
options.D: Because the external field is shielded completely by the surface charges.
